body:
Closes the open question in `forgetting-law` §6 (what a task-aware router buys when tasks conflict).

- Exact law: floor = (2r/d)[τ_w² + τ_b²(1 − Purity)], Purity = Σ_g P(g) Σ_c P(c|g)².
- Random modules buy nothing; perfect block router removes (m−1)/(K−1) of the between-cluster floor; router error costs 2q at first order.
- Verified by simulation (0.3–2.3% agreement), 8 unit tests, purity audit estimator.
- README bullet and `site/projects.json` entry added; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
